answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on directed acyclic graph consensus for throughput. A lagoon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the copper of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a user experience perspective, adoption barriers register, it stays short. What survives to the island is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
